Introduction to Biology

Biology is the scientific study of life and living organisms.
It covers a wide range of topics, from the molecular basis of life
to the ecology of entire ecosystems.

Cell Theory

All living things are composed of cells. The cell is the basic unit of life.
All cells come from pre-existing cells through the process of cell division.

Photosynthesis

Plants convert sunlight into chemical energy through photosynthesis.
This process uses carbon dioxide and water to produce glucose and oxygen.
The overall equation is: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 + 6O2
